about.title: About
about.text: Hey! Nik here from Buenos Aires, Argentina. I’m a musician, producer and mixing engineer. I was made to make heavy, punchy and loud music. I’d be glad to produce and mix your next record! Let’s work together!

services.title: Production
services.text: From pre-production to final takes: arrangement, tones and direction to take your songs further.

services.title: Mixing
services.text: Heavy, punchy and loud mixes that stay tight, clear and defined.

services.title: Mastering
services.text: The final polish and competitive loudness, ready for every platform.

services.title: Writing
services.text: Riffs, arrangements and complete songs written for heavy music.

music.title: Music
